title: 09. Production & Safety: Cost Tracking & Budget Control
summary: Every LLM call costs money. Without tracking, costs spiral out of control.

sections.title: What Is It?
sections.body: > Every LLM call costs money. Without tracking, costs spiral out of control. Cost tracking gives you visibility into **where money goes**, **which users spend most**, and **when to alert** before bills explode.

sections.title: Cost Tracking Explained
sections.body:
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              COST TRACKING — WHY IT MATTERS                     │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  REAL COST BREAKDOWN — Production Agent (10K queries/day):
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  BEFORE COST TRACKING:
  You get your cloud bill: $9,240 this month
  You have NO IDEA why. Was it the new feature? A bug?
  One user hammering the API? You can't tell.

  AFTER COST TRACKING:
  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  Monthly Cost Breakdown:                                 │
  │                                                          │
  │  By Component:                                           │
  │  LLM calls (GPT-4o):    $6,500  (70%)                   │
  │  Embeddings:             $800   (9%)                     │
  │  Tool calls (APIs):      $940   (10%)                    │
  │  Vector DB queries:      $350   (4%)                     │
  │  Other:                  $650   (7%)                     │
  │  Total:                 $9,240                           │
  │                                                          │
  │  By Feature:                                             │
  │  Research agent:        $4,100  (44%) ← expensive!      │
  │  Chat agent:            $2,900  (31%)                    │
  │  Summarization:         $1,200  (13%)                    │
  │  Classification:        $1,040  (11%)                    │
  │                                                          │
  │  By User:                                                │
  │  Top 1% of users:       $1,800  (19%) ← need rate limit │
  │  Normal users:          $7,440  (81%)                    │
  │                                                          │
  │  INSIGHTS:                                               │
  │  → Research agent uses 5x more tokens than needed        │
  │    Fix: optimize system prompt (-200 tokens each)        │
  │    Savings: $1,200/month                                 │
  │  → Top users need cost caps                              │
  │    Fix: $5/user/month limit                              │
  │    Savings: $800/month                                   │
  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  COST ALERTS:
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Alert 1: Single request > $0.50      → notify engineering
  Alert 2: Hourly spend > $50          → check for runaway loop
  Alert 3: Daily spend > $500          → pause + investigate
  Alert 4: Monthly forecast > $15,000  → escalate to management
```
